classification_unit: One primary category per persisted candidate ledger row; saved response-only requests remain pending
validity_denominator: Persisted ledger rows, not unissued budget or in-flight/pending evaluation requests
constant_definition: Exact equality on every saved training score; AUROC 50 alone is insufficient evidence
truncation_definition: Only explicit finish_reason length/max_tokens/max_output_tokens; syntax errors or short output do not imply token exhaustion
missing_statistic_caveat: KeyError records identify a missing runtime key, not necessarily a missing dataset feature

categories.generation_timeout: Generation request timeout or connection timeout
categories.generation_context_limit: Generation server explicitly reports a context-length limit
categories.truncation_parse_extraction: Syntax/extraction failure with an explicit length/max-token finish reason
categories.syntax_extraction: Syntax, indentation or class/code extraction failure without explicit truncation evidence
categories.imports_api: Missing import/name, wrong import location or invalid library/object API
categories.missing_statistic_key: Missing key during candidate execution; original key is retained
categories.ragged_shape_alignment_nonfinite: Array/ragged/axis/index/alignment handling or nonfinite numeric output
categories.exact_duplicate_code: Pipeline rejected an exact duplicate generated program
categories.valid_constant_scores: Pipeline-valid but exactly constant on all saved training rows
categories.valid_nonconstant_scores: Pipeline-valid and nonconstant on saved training rows
categories.valid_constant_status_unknown: Pipeline-valid but training score artifact absent or unreadable
categories.other_failure: Failure not safely assigned to the preceding categories
